verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for a design platform, but the evidence shows no Penpot-native feature for setting up recurring, scheduled or rule-based automations that run on their own. The MCP server is driven by an external agent prompting it ('prompt away'). Outbound webhooks, the plugin API and access tokens are developer building blocks that external systems could use to build automation, not an automation capability of Penpot itself. The 'Automate tedious tasks' claim describes agent-connected workflows, not autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
